fields.Text: {{c1::Conceptual integrity}} is a consistent and unified vision across the entire project, with one source controlling design decisions and complexity hidden behind a simpler, unified interface.

fields.Front: How does conceptual integrity help a team?
fields.Back: It isolates the core complexity of the design so the rest of the team can focus on implementation without worrying about design decisions.

fields.Front: What is modularization and how does it relate to OOP?
fields.Back: Breaking large systems into smaller manageable modules, each with a well-defined interface and hidden internal details, similar to how classes encapsulate complexity.
